_notes: tts  = what the voice says. phon = optional IPA override passed straight to Kokoro.
cap  = on-screen caption. *gold* = emphasis, !red! = loss, +green+ = gain.
{TEXT:N} = show TEXT in place of the next N spoken words (e.g. 'a thousand dollars' -> $1,000).
pause = silence (seconds) after the line; used for countdowns, beats and the end card.

lines.tts: Your money is shrinking right now.
And you can't even see it.
Quick test.
You saved a thousand dollars in twenty twenty.
What can it buy today?
Lock in your guess.
About eight hundred dollars' worth.
Two hundred bucks, gone.
Without spending a cent.
That's inflation.
Groceries. Rent. Gas. Insurance.
Prices climb every single year.
Meanwhile, your savings account pays almost nothing.
lines.cap: Meanwhile, your savings account pays almost *nothing.*

lines.tts: So your balance stays the same, but it buys less every year.
lines.cap: So your balance stays the *same,* but it buys !less! every year.

lines.tts: Now here's what they don't teach you in school.
lines.cap: Now here's what they *don't* *teach* *you* in school.

lines.tts: When new money is created, it doesn't reach everyone at once.
lines.cap: When *new* *money* is created, it doesn't reach everyone at once.

lines.tts: Banks and Wall Street get it first.
Then people who already own assets.
They spend it before prices rise.
By the time it reaches your paycheck, everything already costs more.
lines.cap: By the time it reaches *your* *paycheck,* everything already costs !more.!

lines.tts: This has a name.
The Cantillon Effect.
Save this one.
It's why people who own homes and stocks get richer during inflation,
lines.cap: It's why people who own +homes+ and +stocks+ get +richer+ during inflation,

lines.tts: while people living on a salary fall behind.
lines.cap: while people living on a salary !fall! !behind.!

lines.tts: Not because they work less.
Because cash is designed to lose value.
The Fed literally targets two percent inflation.
Every. Single. Year.
So if your money is just sitting still, it's not safe.
lines.cap: So if your money is just sitting still, it's !not! !safe.!

lines.tts: It's melting.
Follow for part two, how to protect it.
